name: Contract Registration Request V 04
definition: The ContractRegistrationRequest message is sent by the reporting party to the registration agent to initiate the registration of a new contract subject to currency control.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Characteristics shared by all individual items included in the message.

ContractRegistration.name: Contract Registration
ContractRegistration.definition: Identifies the currency control contract details for which the registration is requested.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
